Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Two questions about Diablerie:

Under the description for the "Leave Torpor" action,
it says that a successfully Blocking vampire has the
"opportunity to commit Diablerie". Is this Diablerie
another blockable action? Or is it automatic, as a
result of blocking? I would think it is the latter,
as there's no other way for a minion to normally take
an action out-of-turn.

Secondly, under "Leave Torpor" it explicitly states
that if you fail, you don't pay the two blood. But how
about Rescue? If you are trying to Rescue a vampire
from torpor and are blocked, do you pay the blood or not?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote:
> Under the description for the "Leave Torpor" action,
> it says that a successfully Blocking vampire has the
> "opportunity to commit Diablerie". Is this Diablerie
> another blockable action? Or is it automatic, as a
> result of blocking? I would think it is the latter,
> as there's no other way for a minion to normally take
> an action out-of-turn.

The latter.

> Secondly, under "Leave Torpor" it explicitly states
> that if you fail, you don't pay the two blood. But how
> about Rescue? If you are trying to Rescue a vampire
> from torpor and are blocked, do you pay the blood or not?

Not. Costs of actions are only paid when successful.
